purpose: Teach: 可視/リテラシー/言葉遣い/学ぼ/決行/見立て/置き換える/近接

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業務工程、可視化、急ごう。
lines.en: Let's visualize the workflow and get moving on it.
lines.style: Crisp, direct opening. Light pressure on the forward momentum. Businesslike but not cold — a colleague drafting someone into partnership, not issuing orders.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人のリテラシー、定期チェックします。
lines.en: Got it. I'll set up regular literacy checks for the new hires.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Steady, reliable tone — the kind of person who takes notes mentally. No hesitation, just forward motion.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 電話での言葉遣い、徹底させよう。
lines.en: And let's make sure we nail phone etiquette across the board.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly in the voice. Emphasis on consistency without heaviness. Collaborative framing — 'we' not 'you.' Purposeful but not punitive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。皆で学ぼう、を合言葉に。
lines.en: Absolutely. We'll make "Let's all learn" our rallying call.
lines.style: Warm conviction underneath. Slight lift on 'rallying call' — he's signaling something he believes in, not just executing a checklist. Genuine commitment showing through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: And the launch event — do we move forward with it?
lines.style: Checking in but confident. Genuine curiosity about his read on timing and confidence, not doubt. Open question with an expectation of honest answer.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。マーケットの見立て、強気でいきます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll take a bullish stance on the market positioning.
lines.style: Energy shifts up slightly. Conviction in the voice — not swagger, but grounded confidence. Direct eye contact level in the delivery. He believes this.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 古い社内システム、新規に置き換えるよ。
lines.en: We need to replace the old internal systems with something new.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not harsh. This is practical business — infrastructure that needs upgrading. Steady ownership of the decision without making it sound ominous.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 倉庫、本社近接に移します。
lines.en: I'll relocate the warehouse closer to the main office.
lines.style: Measured, concluding. He's moving through the list of decisions with quiet efficiency. Each item gets its full attention but no drama. Grounded and reliable.
